answer: The sonnet holds work receipts rather than names, so the bridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
